popupWorkProfileConsentPrivacyPreview.message: This extension needs to process your network traffic information, including the domains (i.e., URLs) you visit, the advertisements that you view and your AI requests and responses (including attachments and images) ("Browsing Activity Data") so that it can provide you with our services, such as our ad blocking feature. Certain privacy laws may consider some of the information included in the Browsing Activity Data to be sensitive data, and we may need your consent to process this information. We also need the assistance of our affiliated companies to provide you with some of the extension's services and therefore your Browsing Activity Data will need to be transferred to these affiliates. These affiliates may also use some of the information that we transfer to them for their market intelligence services and may provide this information, including your Browsing Activity Data, to some of their customers under terms that do not allow them to identify you from this data. By clicking "Agree" below you are agreeing to this use and transferring of this information. You are welcome to opt-out of this use at any time but this may have an impact on some of our services.
